scope: Exact V29 source and CPU evidence review; no GPU execution, official call, public promotion or performance claim.

source_findings.parent_restoration: Complete byte restoration and reproduction passed; only SK2 codec, its CUDA literal, preparation, and extension namespace changed.
source_findings.encoding: Each 512-BF16 unit keeps the 768-byte primary plus one 32-bit descriptor. Mode 0 decodes primary, mode 1 repairs one original 16-bit value at its lane/word/half, mode 2 reads an immutable 1024-byte original-unit sidecar.
source_findings.fallback: Weight-only whole-matrix requested-byte threshold chooses the existing other backends when 772*units+1024*raw_units >= 1024*units. No input-dependent output shortcut. Official activation must reject fallback that prevents the intended experiment.

generated_dispatches.limit: Dispatch entries are not distinct compiled pointers; PK variants and shared runtime templates remain separate concepts.

source_findings.lifetime: COMP uses only producer plus regular consumers; empty-barrier count becomes NW, with unchanged per-consumer arrival locations after operand loads. Header and raw operands are read before inherited handback. Removed correction warps, cbar wait and zero-trip correction sums add no new synchronization protocol.
source_findings.state: Raw tensor is retained through the existing untyped ptab ABI with pmax=0; packed stream and its descriptor tail use the same original unit permutation. Other codecs and routing state are unchanged.
source_findings.numerics: Original BF16 operand bits are restored, but removing separate FP32 correction changes accumulation association. CPU bit equality does not establish GPU numerical acceptance.
source_findings.control_scope: Original dense geometry/ring depth, router, UV/BND, PDL and MMA expressions remain. COMP0 generated symbols are renamed but their behavior is intended unchanged.

independent_validation.analyzer_fixture_command: PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_analyze_decoder_v29.py -v
limits: NumPy adapter executes actual packing expressions, not Torch/CUDA kernels.
Exact BF16 operand bits are proven on CPU; tensor MMA and FP32 correction grouping differ and require official numerical tests.
Ring model checks regular-warp ownership and inherited handback order, not CUDA memory ordering or compiler allocation.
Actual numRegs/local/occupancy and selection remain unknown; all eight affected profiles must show compressed V29 activation.

fixed_gate.official_score_formula: Geometric mean of six load scores; each load is sum(weight*baseline_ns)/sum(weight*median_ns), weights sliding=46/full=16.
fixed_gate.activation: All eight affected profiles must match the exact multiset of parent compressed first-seven template integers with COMP argument 8=true and the new sk2_exact_patch_v29 symbol; no residual parent COMP.
fixed_gate.required_identity: Exact candidate, evaluator/image and clean checks/flags; seed may differ between parent runs.
fixed_gate.interpretation: Prespecified operational screen, not a statistical significance or causal attribution claim. Root gate supersedes the earlier supervisor-note proposal.
fixed_gate.failure_action: Close this fixed attempt on correctness, activation or fixed performance-gate failure; no automatic retry, shape rescue or public promotion.

hypothesis_and_risk.falsifiable_prediction: Eliminating correction-warps/table scan/FP32 correction work is worth the uniform header, rare exact repairs and occasional global raw loads across all four affected weighted loads.
hypothesis_and_risk.strongest_failure_case: Correction work is not on the exposed critical path, while every consumer gains descriptor/branch/register work and raw-load stalls; compiler resource changes or FP32 association can negate the gain.
hypothesis_and_risk.cpu_distribution_proxy: Three fixed Gaussian proxy draws contained 23 raw units / 12288 units; requested payload 773.9166667 bytes/unit, +0.7704% over the 768-byte primary. This is not actual Torch CUDA/judged-weight evidence.
hypothesis_and_risk.scenario_limit: Rescales separately profiled shares onto benchmark load times. Conditional sensitivity only: overlap, changed resource pressure and critical path are unknown. V29 alone does not establish the 100% whole-score stretch target.
